name: Love Olympus 2.0
source:
Now that Olympus is under Hera's rule, it's time for you to rise up. Gain powers from each of the gods to overthrow her. This is no longer about seduction.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
现在奥林匹斯山已经落入赫拉的统治之下，你是时候站起来了。从每一位神那里获得力量来推翻她。这不再是诱惑。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
